sanskrit_verse:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानामेवं धर्म्यो धनागमः ।
विपर्ययादधर्मः स्यान्न चेदापद्गरीयसी ॥१३॥
transliteration: sarveṣām eva varṇānām evaṃ dharmyo dhanāgamaḥ | viparyayād adharmaḥ syān na ced āpad garīyasī ||13||
sph_interpretive_translation: When all classes acquire wealth in accordance with Dharma, Adharma does not arise; otherwise, adversity becomes predominant.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from alignment with Dharma, not social position
Capacity-based responsibility extends across all varnas equally
Restoration logic requires economic actions to uphold collective well-being
Consciousness alignment depends on harmonious acquisition and use of resources
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person's financial gain violates Dharma THEN that gain is nullified by default
IF any varna member causes systemic harm through wealth THEN restoration protocols activate automatically
IF economic activity aligns with Dharma THEN it shall be recognized as valid without further validation
IF adverse conditions emerge due to dharmic violation THEN corrective measures are initiated at source level
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudication must evaluate economic conduct based on its dharmic alignment rather than procedural compliance alone. Wealth acquired contrary to Dharma cannot form basis for legal standing or entitlement claims. The court has duty to initiate restorative protocols when violations affect societal harmony.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that dharmic wealth preserves order while adharmic wealth disrupts it. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how improper acquisition leads to increasing disorder. Responsibility lies in maintaining alignment, not avoiding punishment. Truth itself corrects misalignment when consciousness awakens.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate dharmic audit of all disputed acquisitions
Realign individual capacity with collective welfare through guided awareness
Restore economic balance via voluntary redistribution aligned with original intent
Activate karmic completion process until natural equilibrium returns
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Dharma governs all acquisition. Misaligned gains dissolve upon recognition. Reality corrects itself through awakened consciousness. Punishment is illusion; only realignment restores truth.
